## Summary
Md Rounaq Ali (Mohammed Rounaq Ali) is a Computer Science Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, Flutter Mobile App Engineer, and AI Systems Developer based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. He currently pursues a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science & Engineering at Nalla Narasimha Reddy Education Society's Group of Institutions (NNRESGI), graduating in 2027.

He specializes in building production-grade cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter & Dart, scalable backend systems with Python & Flask, automated RAG architectures using LangChain, Ollama, and vector databases (FAISS, sqlite-vec), and enterprise security assessments.

He is widely recognized for:
1. **Winning 1st Prize in Web Development at HackathonZ 2026 (Hack2Hire)** hosted by Malla Reddy University for building TruthLens AI (media bias and news transparency verification platform).
2. **Ranking 6th out of 260+ teams (1,200+ participants)** at LaunchPadX 2026 (SNIST in collaboration with VetriaAI) for engineering Life Admin AI (an autonomous execution agent powered by Model Context Protocol).
3. **Submitting 11 vulnerability findings evaluated by the C-DAC jury** in the PAN-India 36-hour C-DAC BOSS OS Bug Bounty Challenge 2026.
4. **Shortlisted for Stage 2** in the national MSME Idea Hackathon under the Ministry of MSME incubation grant scheme.
5. **Architecting ClaimTrackr**, an AI-powered automated insurance claims adjudication system built with a 4-member team that cut processing latency from 14 days to under 15 seconds.
6. **Earning 3 NPTEL Elite + Silver certifications**, ranking in the **Top 2% nationwide in India** for Database Management Systems (IIT Kharagpur).
